// Chatbot logic function function handleSendMessage() { const inputField = document.querySelector("#chatbot-input"); // Apne input ID se replace karein const chatContainer = document.querySelector("#chat-messages"); // Apne chat box container ID se replace karein const userText = inputField.value.trim().toLowerCase(); if (userText === "") return; // 1. User Message Display Karein appendMessage(userText, 'user'); inputField.value = ""; // 2. Dynamic Bot Response Logic let botResponse = ""; if (userText.includes("order") || userText.includes("buy")) { botResponse = "Order karne ke liye product ke niche 'Buy Now' par click karein ya Add to Cart karke checkout karein."; } else if (userText.includes("return") || userText.includes("policy")) { botResponse = "Return policy ke liye Video Proof zaroori hai. Aap Support section se policy detail dekh sakte hain."; } else if (userText.includes("price") || userText.includes("kitne ka")) { botResponse = "Aap kisi bhi product ki price uski card image ke niche dekh sakte hain."; } else { botResponse = "Main aapki kya madad kar sakta hoon? Aap order, return policy, ya prices ke baare mein pooch sakte hain."; } // 3. Bot Message Display Karein setTimeout(() => { appendMessage(botResponse, 'bot'); }, 500); } function appendMessage(text, sender) { const chatContainer = document.querySelector("#chat-messages"); const msgDiv = document.createElement("div"); msgDiv.className = sender === 'user' ? 'user-msg' : 'bot-msg'; msgDiv.innerText = text; chatContainer.appendChild(msgDiv); chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight; } A&M Online Store | Complete E-Commerce Platform
